query: Port Solas recorded electricity consumption anomaly during the 2013-10-03 12:00–13:00 forecast window

evidence.claim: A one-hour synchronization error caused recorded electricity consumption to be 40 percent lower without an actual reduction in power usage.
evidence.exact_quote: The 40% reduction is determined to be a result of the software’s failure to aggregate sub-meter packets during the sync lag, rather than an actual drop in facility power usage.

impacts.rationale: The document explicitly attributes a 40% reduction in recorded values during the 12:00–13:00 synchronization-error window to missing sub-meter packets, so the forecast should preserve the latent consumption pattern but reduce the recorded value for that hour by 40%.
